description.value: Samz is a neighbourhood pub in Surrey offering food, drinks, and live sports viewing, with an attached liquor store on the same premises. It is one of two Lower Mainland locations operated by the same company, and the Surrey pub also carries Skip the Dishes delivery. The liquor store next door stocks beer, wine, and spirits at competitive prices, making this a convenient stop for cyclists looking to resupply.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched from https://www.samz.ca/ and confirms the Surrey location at 19580 56 Avenue Surrey, BC V3S 6K4 with pub phone 604-530-4000, corroborating the OSM address. The homepage prominently features 'Order With Skip The Dishes – Surrey Location', confirming takeout is available. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the menu is only available as a PDF download so dietary options cannot be verified.
concerns: OSM name is 'Samz Pub' but the website consistently uses 'Samz Neighbourhood Pub' — minor discrepancy retained per rules.
OSM record contains no phone number; phone 604-530-4000 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pub with a confirmed address and working website; publicly accessible to walk-in customers including touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: one of two Lower Mainland locations operated by the same company
